interpretation.occupation: Measured watchdog wall includes successful preflight, CPU/setup, online, offline and failures; not GPU-active time.
interpretation.additivity: Only totals.mutually_exclusive_addends sum to cumulative charged time. Children partition attempt; driver/online/setup views are nested and never additional fees.
interpretation.workspace: anchor/pool/projection are nested inside public_workspace; not additive to its containing interval.
interpretation.finalist: Initial Jx and batched finalist Jd physical RHS from actual counters; selected versus unselected wall separation unavailable.
interpretation.cold: Reconstructed standalone setup+policy fees reuse shared acquisition; no independent cold timing available.
interpretation.gaussian: Cached logical teacher labels do not imply physical RHS. This audit uses actual physical counters only, never TeacherContext.counts.
interpretation.unavailable: No reliable terminal child CPU total, no exact continuous CUDA-active wall, no per-k offline wall, no individual accepted/rejected Jd wall.
interpretation.overlap: UTC start/end are ordered and nonoverlapping; successful preflight begins before start UTC. Occupation uses monotonic measured duration, not UTC differences.
